Plot spatial clustering results

Source: R/clustering_runner.R
plot_spatial_clustering.Rd

Visualise predicted spatial clusters and ground-truth annotations across normalisation methods.

Usage

plot_spatial_clustering(
  norm_list,
  cluster_col = "banksy_cluster",
  methods = names(norm_list),
  method_order = NULL,
  point_size = 0.5,
  palette = NULL,
  ncol = 3,
  legend_point_size = 4,
  theme_name = "classic",
  ground_truth_col = NULL,
  show = c("predicted", "both", "truth"),
  truth_palette = NULL
)

Arguments

norm_list

Named list of SpatialExperiment objects or nested lists of SpatialExperiment objects.

cluster_col

Column containing predicted clusters.

methods

Optional normalisation methods to plot.

method_order

Optional method order.

point_size

Spatial point size.

palette

Optional named colours for predicted clusters.

ncol

Number of columns for spatial facets.

legend_point_size

Point size in legends.

theme_name

Plot theme.

ground_truth_col

Ground-truth annotation column.

show

One of "both", "predicted", or "truth".

truth_palette

Optional named colours for ground truth.

Value

List containing data, palettes, individual plots, and combined plot.

Details

When show = "both", the ground truth is displayed once per spatial slice, followed by predicted cluster maps across all selected normalisation methods.

Predicted clusters share one colour scale and legend. Ground truth uses a separate palette and legend.

Examples

data(norm_example)

banksy_norm <- run_banksy_individual(
  norm_list = norm_example,
  k_geom = 15,
  lambda = 0.8,
  resolution = 0.2,
  seed = 123
)
#> Computing neighbors...
#> Spatial mode is kNN_median
#> Parameters: k_geom=15
#> Done

#> Using seed=123
#> Computing neighbors...
#> Spatial mode is kNN_median
#> Parameters: k_geom=15
#> Done

#> Using seed=123

p <- plot_spatial_clustering(
  norm_list = banksy_norm,
  cluster_col = "banksy_cluster",
  ground_truth_col = "layer_guess",
  show = "both",
  point_size = 0.5,
  ncol = 2,
  theme_name = "classic"
)

p$plot
